units.source_text: 自从医生命令静卧以来，父亲大小便都是躺在床上，靠别人伺候的。

en.t: Ever since the doctor ordered him to stay in bed, Father had had to relieve himself lying there, with others taking care of him.

units.source_text: 特别爱干净的父亲，最初一段时间很不情愿，无奈身子不听使唤，也只好勉强这样了。

en.t: Father was especially fastidious about cleanliness, and at first he hated it, but since his body would not obey him, he had no choice but to accept it reluctantly.

units.source_text: 而且由于病情日渐沉重，父亲的脑子好像也越来越迟钝，日子久了，就变得满不在乎了。

en.t: And as his illness grew worse day by day, Father's mind seemed to grow duller too; after a while he became completely indifferent.

units.source_text: 有时弄脏了被褥，旁人见了都皱眉头，他反倒无所谓。

en.t: At times he soiled the bedding, and though the people around him frowned at the sight, he himself was unconcerned.

units.source_text: 不过，得了这种病，尿量特别少，医生也束手无策。

en.t: Still, with this illness, the amount of urine was extremely small, and there was nothing the doctor could do.

units.source_text: 父亲的食欲也渐渐减弱了，偶尔想吃什么，也只是嘴里头馋，根本咽不下去多少，

en.t: Father's appetite gradually weakened as well; even when he occasionally wanted to eat something, it was only a craving in his mouth, and he could hardly swallow anything,

units.source_text: 连一向喜欢看的报纸都没有气力拿了。

en.t: he no longer even had the strength to pick up the newspaper he had always liked to read.

units.source_text: 放在枕边的老花镜，也好久没有从黑眼镜盒里拿出来了。

en.t: The reading glasses kept by his pillow, too, had not been taken out of their black case for a long time.

units.source_text: 父亲有个发小，名叫阿作，住在相隔七八里远的地方。

en.t: Father had a childhood friend named Asaku, who lived seven or eight li away.

units.source_text: 他前来探望时，“哦，是阿作啊？”

en.t: When he came to visit, Father said, "Oh, is that Asaku?"

units.source_text: 父亲睁开混浊的眼睛望着他说，“阿作，谢谢你来看我。

en.t: Father opened his cloudy eyes, looked at him, and said, "Asaku, thank you for coming to see me.

units.source_text: 看你这么结实，真叫人羡慕啊。

en.t: Seeing how sturdy you are really makes me envious.

units.source_text: 老哥，你两个孩子都是大学毕业，就算得了点儿病，也没什么可埋怨的！

en.t: Old friend, both your children graduated from university, so even if you have fallen a little ill, you have nothing to complain about!

units.source_text: 你看看我，老婆子死了，又没个孩子，

en.t: Look at me: my wife is dead, and I have no children,

units.source_text: 就这么孤单单地凑合活着，身子骨再结实，也没什么意思呀。”

en.t: so I just scrape along alone like this; no matter how healthy my body is, there is no joy in it."
